tools.name: stage_image
tools.title: Save an image for a card
tools.description: Save an image file, a PDF figure or part of a PDF page for a card and return its tag. The image goes into the user's images folder; Anki gets a copy with draft_commit. Look at the returned thumbnail.

source.description: Image or PDF on the user's computer (absolute path), or an image URL
source.title: Source

figure.description: PDF: figure id from pdf_figures, e.g. 'p3f1'
figure.title: Figure

page.description: PDF: page number, when no figure is given
page.title: Page

region.description: Part to cut out: [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions (0-1) of the page or image
region.title: Region

tools.name: pdf_figures
tools.title: Find figures in a PDF
tools.description: List the figures (diagrams, photos, plots) on PDF pages with their ids, regions and captions.

path.description: PDF on the user's computer (absolute path)
path.title: Path

pages.description: Pages to search, e.g. '3' or '2-5,8' (at most 20)
pages.title: Pages

show_page.description: Also return the first page as a picture, with the figures boxed and a 10% grid
show_page.title: Show Page

tools.name: render_graph
tools.title: Draw a graph
tools.description: Draw a graph, tree or automaton with Graphviz and return its tag for a card field. The image goes into the user's images folder. Node labels can be hidden later with draft_add_occlusion.

dot.description: Graphviz DOT source, e.g. 'digraph { A -> B }'
dot.title: Dot

tools.name: overview
tools.title: Decks and note types
tools.description: The decks with their card counts and the note types with their exact field names. Call it before drafting.

deck.description: Only this deck and its subdecks
deck.title: Deck

tools.name: search_notes
tools.title: Search notes
tools.description: Find notes with Anki's search syntax. One line per note, newest first, or all of them into a Markdown file.

save_to.description: Instead of listing: write every match (up to 2000) in full as Markdown to this file, an absolute path ending in .md, e.g. for notes or a summary
save_to.title: Save To

tools.name: update_notes
tools.title: Update notes
tools.description:
Change fields of existing notes. Keeps the review history, so prefer it over deleting and re-adding.

Notes not created by this plugin need force=true: only for a change the user asked for, otherwise ask them
first. Returns a batch id for undo.

fields.description: Only the fields that change, with their full new content
fields.title: Fields

force.description: Needed for notes the user wrote: only for a change the user asked for
force.title: Force

tools.name: delete_notes
tools.title: Delete notes
tools.description:
Delete notes created by this plugin. Their review history is lost for good.

Only for cards that should not exist at all; fix wrong cards with update_notes instead. The user confirms in a
dialog where their client can show one. Returns a batch id: undo adds the notes back with their fields, tags and
deck, but without the review history.

tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo a batch
tools.description:
Revert a draft_commit, update_notes, delete_notes or math_css by its batch id: added notes are deleted,
changed fields and styling restored, deleted notes added back without their review history.

Notes the user studied or edited since are left alone and listed. With force=true the user confirms deleting
them in a dialog where their client can show one.

force.description: Commits only: also delete notes studied or edited since, with their history. Ask first
force.title: Force

tools.name: math_css
tools.title: Let long formulas scroll on phones
tools.description:
Add CSS to note types so that a display formula wider than the screen scrolls sideways on a phone instead
of running off the card. Only their styling changes. Returns a batch id for undo.

tools.name: sync
tools.title: Sync with AnkiWeb
tools.description: Sync the collection with AnkiWeb, so new cards reach the user's phone and reviews from the phone count.

tools.name: stats
tools.title: Study statistics
tools.description:
How the collection is doing, and the notes the user struggles with most.

Health: card counts, reviews per day, true retention.
Weak notes: ranked by again rate, lapses and FSRS difficulty, with flags that hint at the cause.

scope.description: Anki search that limits the cards, e.g. 'deck:GAD'
scope.title: Scope

weak_limit.description: How many weak notes to list; 0 for none
weak_limit.title: Weak Limit

tools.name: draft_add
tools.title: Add cards to a draft
tools.description:
Check cards against Anki and add them to a draft. Nothing is written to Anki.

Pass 'cards', or 'cards_text' for cards with LaTeX. LaTeX that lost a backslash in JSON is repaired.
Returns the cards as text to show the user (no HTML, & shows as &). If any card has a problem,
none is added and every problem is listed.

fields.description: Field name -> content (HTML), names exactly as overview lists them
fields.title: Fields

tags.description: Tags for this card, on top of the call's tags
tags.title: Tags

note_type.description: Only if it differs from the call's note type
note_type.title: Note Type

deck.description: Only if it differs from the call's deck
deck.title: Deck

cards_text.description: Instead of 'cards': the cards as plain text, where LaTeX needs no doubled backslashes. Each card starts with a line '## ', optionally '| deck: | tags: ' after it ('##' alone: the call's note type). Then 'Field: content' lines; a field runs until the next field name or '##', its line breaks become
cards_text.title: Cards Text

draft_id.description: Add to this draft. Without it a new draft is created
draft_id.title: Draft Id

deck.description: Deck of these cards, full name, e.g. 'Math::Analysis'. A new draft needs it
deck.title: Deck

note_type.description: Note type of these cards, e.g. 'Basic'. A new draft needs it
note_type.title: Note Type

tags.description: Tags for these cards. A new draft also gives them to later cards
tags.title: Tags

title.description: A short name for the draft
title.title: Title

allow_duplicate.description: Allow cards whose first field already exists
allow_duplicate.title: Allow Duplicate

echo.description: false: reply with card numbers, repairs and warnings only, not the cards. For when the user said to add the cards without seeing them, or when nobody reads them
echo.title: Echo

tools.name: draft_add_occlusion
tools.title: Add an image occlusion card to a draft
tools.description:
Add an Image Occlusion note (Anki 23.10+) to a draft. Each mask, or each group of masks, becomes one card.

Returns the image with the masks drawn in. Check that every mask covers exactly its label.

image.description: Image file name from stage_image or render_graph, e.g. 'heart.png'
image.title: Image

label.description: Text on the image (a PDF word or a graph node) to hide
label.title: Label

region.description: Area to hide instead of a label: [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions (0-1) of the image
region.title: Region

group.description: Masks with the same group are asked together on one card
group.title: Group

header.description: Shown above the image, e.g. what to name
header.title: Header

back_extra.description: Shown below the image on the back
back_extra.title: Back Extra

hide_all.description: True: all masks hidden, one asked. False: only the asked mask hidden
hide_all.title: Hide All

draft_id.description: Add to this draft. Without it a new draft is created
draft_id.title: Draft Id

tags.description: Tags for this card. A new draft also gives them to later cards
tags.title: Tags

title.description: A short name for the draft
title.title: Title

tools.name: draft_edit
tools.title: Change cards in a draft
tools.description:
Change, move or remove cards of a draft by number, or find and replace across all its cards.

Send only the fields that change; the others stay. Returns the changed cards as text to show the user.

card.description: Card number in the draft, e.g. 3 for #3
card.title: Card

tags.description: Replaces all tags of the card
tags.title: Tags

deck.description: Moves the card to this deck (full name)
deck.title: Deck

remove.description: Remove the card from the draft
remove.title: Remove

find.description: Text to find; a Python regular expression with regex=true
find.title: Find

replacement.description: What replaces it. With regex=true, \1 and \g<name> insert a group
replacement.title: Replacement

cards.description: Only these card numbers. Without it: every card
cards.title: Cards

fields.description: Only these fields. Without it: every field
fields.title: Fields

replace.description: Find and replace across the draft, applied before 'edits'
replace.title: Replace

echo.description: false: reply with card numbers and problems only, not the cards
echo.title: Echo

tools.name: draft_show
tools.title: Show a draft
tools.description: Show the cards of a draft as text, or list the open drafts. Drafts survive restarts.

draft_id.description: Without it: list the open drafts
draft_id.title: Draft Id

tools.name: draft_commit
tools.title: Add draft cards to Anki
tools.description:
Add the cards the user approved to Anki. Missing decks are created. Returns a batch id for undo.

Cards that fail stay in the draft with the reason. The draft is deleted when no cards are left.

cards.description: Only these card numbers. Without it: all cards
cards.title: Cards

confirm.description: false only when the user said to add the cards without asking, e.g. 'commit them directly'. Otherwise their client asks them once more in a dialog
confirm.title: Confirm

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.title: YouTube transcript
tools.description:
Read the transcript of a YouTube video, in the video's own language unless another is asked for.

A long video returns a timestamped outline instead; call again with 'intervals' to read the parts that matter.

language.description: Language code, e.g. 'de'. Without it: the video's own language
language.title: Language
